data.status: hoping to open by March Madness in 2027
data.short_description: Loc@l, a drinks-centric bar from the owners of the Clawson location, is expanding to a second location in Downtown Detroit near the Fox Theater. The 1,800-square-foot space will feature 12 taps, specialty cocktails, and a patio. Co-owner Jacob Kruk said the team hopes to open by March Madness in 2027.

data.status: prepares to open its first brick-and-mortar location
data.short_description: Stelly's Frozen Yogurt, currently a mobile trailer operation, is preparing to open its first brick-and-mortar location at 4711 Freret St in Uptown. The shop uses a scratch-made, four-ingredient fro-yo base with weekly rotating flavors and house-made toppings.

Fluffies Hot Chicken, a family-run chicken sandwich chain from New Jersey, will open its next location at 273 Canal St. in the Chinatown/SoHo area. The new spot will offer breakfast and char-grilled chicken tenders, joining existing NYC outposts.

Austin-based acai bowl and smoothie chain Blenders and Bowls permanently closed its Eastside location after serving its last drink on August 23, ending a decade-long run. The team said they decided not to renew the lease and will focus on new endeavors, while their Westlake and Lamar locations remain open.

Potbelly Sandwich Shop is making its Georgia debut on September 1 at Peachtree Station Shopping Center in Chamblee, with a grand opening celebration set for September 19. The event will feature a ribbon-cutting, free Potbelly for a year for the first 50 guests, Plinko games, and giveaways.

Stumptown Coffee Roasters is set to open its new flagship café in Lincoln Heights on August 29, inside the former Starland Theater. The opening marks the brand's return to central Los Angeles, with the grand opening event featuring special drinks and exclusive merchandise for the first 100 guests.

data.location: 5220 Buffalo Speedway, Houston, TX 77005, United States
data.short_description: Houston's Shiva Indian Restaurant permanently closed after 35 years, serving its final meal on August 13 and closing online ordering. The team cited retirement as the reason behind the closure and thanked the community for its support.

data.status: will open / grand opening Saturday and Sunday, Sept. 12-13
data.short_description: PRESS Coffee will open its new Camelview location inside an Arcadia office building at 5090 N 40th St, marking its 21st location across the Valley. The grand opening celebration is set for Sept. 12-13 with complimentary treats and giveaways.

LIBA, from the team behind 12 Chairs Café, is opening at The William Vale, centered around an open kitchen with an 800-degree brick oven and in-house dry-aging program. The menu draws on contemporary Mediterranean and Middle Eastern cooking under Culinary Director Chef Maayan Glass.

data.location: Midtown Union, Midtown Atlanta (Address not specified)
data.short_description: A new Fleming's Prime Steakhouse & Wine Bar location is opening at Midtown Union in Midtown Atlanta, occupying 8,233 square feet. It will open this fall, serving lunch and dinner daily beginning at 11 a.m., known for premium steak cuts and a curated wine collection.

Illusion Sports Bar is opening a new location in Buckhead this year, taking over a 3,100-square-foot space currently undergoing renovations. The bar will feature indoor seating, multiple TVs, a patio with a jumbotron, and will serve burgers and wings.
Henri's Bakery & Deli is expanding to Athens this fall. Further details on the location were not provided in the available text.

A new Chick-fil-A restaurant will begin serving the Stockton community on Thursday, Aug. 27, 2026, at 6:30 a.m. April Farage, the local Owner-Operator, will operate this as her second restaurant in the community, with an opening-day "Moove-In Party" celebration.

Mason's Famous Lobster Rolls is closing its St. Johns Town Center location in Jacksonville on August 25, 2026, after 22 months of service. The Annapolis-based seafood chain announced the closure on social media, thanking the community for their support.

data.status: showing signs of forward momentum / getting closer to opening
data.short_description: Tacos-n-Ganas is moving forward on a new location at 3686 Riverdale Road, having received a commercial mechanical permit on August 17. The permit covers installation of a fire suppression system, kitchen hood, walk-in cooler, and grills, indicating progress toward opening.

Construction is underway on Big Bad Breakfast's new Cooper-Young location at 2149 Young Avenue. The restaurant received its sign permit on August 18, and social media posts describe progress being made rapidly on the storefront.

data.status: seeking approval to upgrade and reopen
data.short_description: Franchisee Wendelta is seeking approval to upgrade and reopen a Poplar Avenue Wendy's location in Germantown. Plans presented at the August 20 Planning Commission meeting include new wall tiles, an exterior canopy, new windows, and relocation of the drive-thru window.

data.status: has filed papers to develop / opening timeline is not presently available
data.short_description: Royal Farms has filed papers to develop a third area storefront at 397 Watkins Mill Road in Gaithersburg, spanning 5,380 square feet with gas pumps and a convenience store. An opening timeline is not presently available for the concept.

data.status: too early in development to reasonably estimate an opening timeline
data.short_description: Taco Bell is moving toward opening its first Centreville location with a drive-thru, filing papers with Fairfax County. The 2,800-square-foot restaurant would replace a single-family home and garage on a 1-acre lot. Rezoning and a special exception are still needed.

data.status: opening timeline not presently available; construction is underway
data.short_description: Wonder food hall is opening a new DMV location at Broadlands Village Center in Ashburn, taking over the former Bonefish Grill space. The storefront isn't yet listed on the company's website, but construction is underway.

Honeymoon Chicken is bringing its elevated fried chicken concept to Carlyle Crossing in Alexandria. Construction hoarding and a "coming soon" banner are up, though no official opening date has been set.

data.status: aiming to have the restaurant customer-ready by late autumn
data.short_description: Ted's Bulletin is under construction at Carlyle Crossing in Alexandria, with hospitality group Catalogue targeting an opening before year-end. Construction hoarding and a "coming soon" banner are visible at the site.

data.status: exact opening date has been set for 5 October 2026
data.short_description: 7 Brew Coffee is planning a new drive-thru-only location in Amelia, Ohio, expanding its Cincinnati-area presence. Rick Nader is the franchisee behind the project.

data.status: expected to open in North Beach this fall
data.short_description: Chef Giorgio Rapicavoli is expanding his Luca restaurant family with Luca Trattoria, taking over the former Las Vacas Gordas space in Normandy Isles. It will be a sister concept to his Luca Osteria in Coral Gables.

data.status: An opening date has not yet been announced
data.short_description: Azul Modern Mexican Cuisine is coming to Coral Gables, taking over the former Kao Sushi & Grill space. The company has filed permit applications with Florida's DBPR; this will be owner Franklin Andrade's second location.

data.status: planned expansion over the next seven years
data.short_description: Gong Cha has signed a franchise development deal to bring 50 new locations to San Antonio, Houston, Dallas-Fort Worth and Austin. Specific locations and store counts per market have not yet been announced.

data.short_description: 7 Brew Coffee is planning a new drive-thru-only location in Corpus Christi, per a TDLR filing. Construction is scheduled to begin January 4, 2027, with completion anticipated April 12, 2027.

data.short_description: Wingstop is planning a new San Antonio location on WW White Road involving renovations to an existing building. Construction is scheduled to begin October 18, 2026, with completion anticipated January 26, 2027.

data.status: currently in the development and construction phase and is targeting a Fall 2026 opening
data.short_description: AstroBite, an independently created "Eat • Drink • Play" concept combining food, a bar and video gaming, is taking shape in Posen. Owner Dimple Naik is targeting a Fall 2026 opening pending permits and approvals.

data.status: exact grand opening date has not been publicly announced
data.short_description: Jones Road Beauty is preparing to open a boutique at Fashion Island in Newport Beach, per the shopping center's directory. The makeup brand, founded by Bobbi Brown, will offer an experiential boutique with bookable services.

data.location: 597 Roger Williams Ave, Highland Park, IL 60035
data.short_description: EATACO is expanding beyond its Northbrook home with a new location in Highland Park's Ravinia District. The opening is part of owner Serah Cicek's broader restaurant portfolio expansion in the area.

data.short_description: A California ABC filing lists Korean seafood restaurant Venice Beach at a new address within The Source OC in Buena Park, different from its current unit. The filing may suggest a potential relocation, but this is unconfirmed.

Fleming's Prime Steakhouse & Wine Bar is preparing to open a new Riverside location at The Mark, a mixed-use development downtown. The restaurant will include a 107-seat dining room, private dining spaces and a large outdoor patio.
Deep Purpl, a Chicago açaí bowl and smoothie brand, is taking over the former Sip & Savor space in the South Loop. Owner Gabriel Fleury said he had been looking for a spot in the area for years.

data.status: still moving through the permitting process, putting it behind the anticipated debut schedule
data.short_description: Culver's is coming to the South Loop via franchisee Baron Waller, marking his eleventh location. The restaurant, occupying a former Aurelio's Pizza space, had originally been hoped to open by summer but is delayed in permitting.

data.location: 159 W Yosemite Ave, Manteca, CA 95336, USA
data.short_description: Levelz Lounge, a "premium entertainment lounge," is set to open in downtown Manteca after winning city approval via a conditional use permit. The license backing it was relocated from Tracy to the Manteca address.

data.location: 1402 S El Camino Real, San Clemente, CA 92672
data.short_description: Haggo's Organic Taco is preparing to open a new restaurant in San Clemente, expanding beyond its existing Encinitas location. The concept focuses on organic, scratch-made Mexican-inspired food.

data.short_description: Café Ikebana is preparing to open a café and lounge concept on Castro Street in Mountain View, taking over the former Vaso Azzurro Ristorante space. It will shift from daytime matcha and café offerings to an evening cocktail lounge.

data.short_description: Namkeen, a Nashville hot chicken concept with South Asian flavors, is planned for Beacon Square in Plano — its first Texas location. Franchisee Mohammed Shaikh said the diverse, family-oriented area was a strong fit for the brand.

data.short_description: A second Firehouse Subs is planned for Austin's Mueller district in East Austin. The project is also led by franchisee Brian Eckel of Central Texas Restaurant Group.

data.short_description: Roma Antica, a San Francisco-based Italian restaurant, is opening a new location in downtown San Mateo. Owner Roberto Sbaraglia said the team is currently training staff ahead of opening.

data.short_description: Innerbloom is preparing to open a restaurant and community gathering space on Polk Street. Owner Anthony Niboli said the partners are currently installing kitchen appliances before the health and safety process.

data.short_description: Maxie's, currently operating on the Las Vegas Strip, is set to open a second location in Henderson. The owner and GM did not respond to requests for comment.

data.short_description: Nothing Bundt Cakes is set to open its first Missouri City store in the Fort Bend Town Center. Construction just began under franchisee Tuyet Duong.

data.short_description: Fogo de Chão, a Brazilian steakhouse chain, plans a new Livonia, MI restaurant — its second in Michigan after Troy. The operating entity has filed for a liquor license per city council records.

Nora's Cuisine, a Las Vegas Italian eatery, is opening its second location in Boulder City's downtown, taking over the former Milo's space. Owner Marcello Mauro confirmed the opening but shared no further details.

data.short_description: Novice is a new bar coming to the historic Moncrief Lenoir campus redevelopment in Houston's Fifth Ward. Construction is planned to start mid-September, led by Deal Co. founder Jon Deal.

data.status: "expanding to Wellesley Square This Fall," "preparing to open"
data.short_description: SALT Patisserie, a Newton Centre pastry shop blending French technique with Brazilian flavors, is opening a second location in Wellesley Square. Founder Thiago Silva shared footage of the window signage going up.

data.status: "set to open," "lists an opening in October 2026"
data.short_description: Stouthaus Coffee Roasters, a Sunset Valley coffee pub and roaster, plans a second brick-and-mortar café on Davis Lane in Austin. It follows its original South Lamar location.

data.status: "slated to open in late fall 2026," construction already underway
data.short_description: Town House Cafe & Bistro is taking over Wayland's historic former Town Hall and library building as a café, bistro, and event space. Founder Kirstyn Lipson has been planning the concept for nearly two decades.
Gibsons Restaurant Group is opening Gibsons Tavern, a relaxed tavern-style concept, in Chicago's Fulton Market. The company is currently recruiting hospitality and culinary staff.

data.status: "confirmed that an opening is targeted for January 2027"
data.short_description: Eggs Up Grill, a South Carolina-based breakfast and brunch chain, plans to open in the Shops at Greenlawn in Round Rock. Franchisee Michael Boselah also has future locations planned in Liberty Hill or Georgetown.
Sid's Tavern is opening in Seattle's Pioneer Square, envisioned by owner Farshid Varamini as a modern-day "Cheers." The menu will focus on elevated American fare like smash burgers and steak frites.

data.status: "preparing to return," "expected to open in Fall 2026"
data.short_description: Café Vida is returning to Pacific Palisades in the former K Bakery Eatery + Bakeshop space after its previous location was destroyed by the January 2025 Palisades Fire. The company has submitted a liquor license application.

data.location: 1701 E Houston St, San Antonio, TX 78202
data.status: "preparing to open," "target opening date of September 2026"
data.short_description: Oringo Africana, owned by Ugochukwu Ijoma, is opening San Antonio's first brick-and-mortar Nigerian restaurant. The concept grew from a home-based food business before expanding to a physical location.

data.location: 133 N Twin Oaks Valley Rd, Suite 100, San Marcos, CA 92069
data.status: "getting ready to open," "exact opening date has not yet been announced"
data.short_description: BHC Chicken, a South Korean fried chicken chain, is opening a new San Marcos location that will replace a Subway in Civic Center Plaza. It's likely another project from franchise owner John Baik.

data.status: "getting ready to open," "scheduled to open on October 19"
data.short_description: Texas Roadhouse is opening a new steakhouse location in the Camarillo Premium Outlets. The restaurant will be managed by Zully Vix.

Santo Poco is a new lunch-only sandwich concept from chef Pablo Becker, planned upstairs from his existing restaurant Fish Guts in Barrio Logan. It will focus on takeout and delivery rather than dine-in service.

Concrete Cowboy is Pablo Becker's second new concept, taking over the former Lia's Lumpia location across from Fish Guts. It will focus on tacos featuring meats like duck confit, ribeye, pork belly, and skirt steak.

data.location: 2222 Logan Ave, San Diego, CA 92113 (upstairs space)
data.short_description: After Concrete Cowboy opens, Fish Guts will temporarily close for remodeling. It is expected to return with a warmer interior and an updated menu.

data.status: hoping to open before the end of August
data.short_description: Smoking LeRoy's, a popular Memphis food truck, is opening its first brick-and-mortar restaurant at Top Gun Memphis, taking over the former Fox Ridge Pizza space. The menu will feature slow-smoked BBQ, Southern comfort food, breakfast items, and sandwiches.

Shawarma Stop is opening its third location in the former Kong Dog space in Naperville, expanding beyond its Schaumburg and Buffalo Grove restaurants. The concept centers on shawarma wraps and other Mediterranean-inspired dishes.

Bingtanghulu is a new Chinese restaurant slated to take over the former BE Pasta Bar space in Brookline. It was recently approved for an entertainment and outdoor dining license and is expected to specialize in the traditional Chinese candied fruit snack of the same name.

data.location: 702 N Person St, Raleigh, NC 27604, USA
data.event_date: end of September or beginning of October
data.short_description: Gallicchio's Market & Eatery is a new restaurant and neighborhood market from chef Stacy Gallicchio Murphy, taking shape in a former neighborhood pharmacy building on Person Street. It will feature an antipasti case, prepared foods to take home, and a roughly 30-seat eatery.

Level 1 Arcade Bar is preparing to open a new Tempe location at the corner of Mill Avenue and University Drive, its second active location and third overall. The venue will offer arcade and pinball games alongside a full kitchen, draft beers, and signature cocktails.

data.location: One Grand Central, New York, NY
data.short_description: TENSHOU Japanese Omakase Collection plans to open a location near Grand Central offering sushi, kaiseki, contemporary Japanese cuisine, tempura and yakitori. The venture is led by CEO Shane Kaj of Round One Delicious USA Inc.

The Broadway TENSHOU location will bring together six dining concepts including sushi, kaiseki, yakitori, tempura and fine Chinese cuisine under one roof. Both TENSHOU locations will feature the cocktail bar Bar Centifolia.

data.location: 101 W San Antonio St, Fredericksburg, TX 78624, USA
data.short_description: Gulf Ranch is a new seafood-focused restaurant from Jesse and Sarah Barter, owners of Hill & Vine, blending Gulf Coast cuisine with Hill Country influences. It aims to bring fresh, sustainably sourced Gulf seafood to Fredericksburg.

data.store_name: Patsy Ruth's Piano Bar and Cabaret
data.short_description: Patsy Ruth's Piano Bar and Cabaret is a new music and dining venue from dentist-turned-hospitality-owner Stuart Williams, taking over a space that previously housed Lost Pizza Co. and Ronnie Grisanti & Sons. The 4,500-square-foot venue will require renovations including a stage expansion and new sound control area.

Kupcakerie, currently operating one location in Downtown East Point, has a new Smyrna location in development according to an Instagram post. The brand offers cupcakes in flavors including red velvet, Churro, and Wedding Bells.

An additional Kupcakerie location is on the way to Grant Park, expanding the cupcake brand beyond its Smyrna and East Point locations. The ownership team did not respond with opening timeline details.

data.location: 3083 Wilma Rudolph Blvd, Clarksville, TN 37040, USA
data.short_description: First Watch, a breakfast, brunch and lunch concept, is under construction at the former Shoney's site in Clarksville, marking the brand's entry into that market. First Watch did not respond to a request for more opening details.
Noori Food Hall is a new food hall coming to Lilburn from Hameed Noori and Hamid Noori, with buildout beginning in July. The hall will offer burgers, pizza, shawarma, wings, coffee, and ice cream.

Frozen dessert franchise Jeremiah's Italian Ice has a Woodstock location in the works after franchisee Nick Patel signed a lease. The brand, founded in 1996, offers the Jelati along with various Italian ice and soft ice cream flavors.

data.location: 597 E Main St, Mayo, FL 32066, USA
data.short_description: The Gathering, an existing restaurant operating in Branford and Live Oak for 19 years, is planning a new Mayo location with a drive-thru at the former NAPA Auto Parts property. There is no confirmed opening date yet.

data.location: Raleigh, NC 27601 (exact site not yet selected)
data.short_description: Shipley Do-Nuts is coming to the Raleigh area with franchise owner Dana Norman bringing two locations to the Triangle. The chain, known for doughnuts and kolaches, has grown to more than 400 locations since 1936.

data.location: Raleigh, NC 27601 (exact site not yet selected)
data.short_description: A second Shipley Do-Nuts location will follow the first in the Triangle, marking Dana Norman's first franchise with the brand. An exact site for either location has not yet been selected.

Mills Night Market, from restaurateurs Johnny and Jimmy Tung, is taking over the former Little Saigon space and will build on past pop-up night market events. It will include multiple concepts, a cocktail bar, and The Mahjong Parlor.

Good Bones Coffee is one of three new concepts from Here Today Brewery & Kitchen opening inside the former Theo Chocolate building in Fremont. Additional menu and opening date details have not yet been announced.

Glitter Paw Lounge, a cocktail and snack bar, is another of Here Today Brewery & Kitchen's three new concepts planned for the former Theo Chocolate building in Fremont. The name shares its branding with the brewery's best-selling Glitter Paw Hazy IPA.

Marigolds, a small cocktail and oyster bar, rounds out the trio of new concepts Here Today Brewery & Kitchen is opening in Fremont's former Theo Chocolate building. The property is a 121-year-old former Fremont Trolley Barn.

Two Jerks Seafood, formerly a seafood market, closed and is being reborn as a restaurant in Port Orange. Co-owner Michael Freeman confirmed the restaurant's opening and said more launch details will be released soon.

data.status: signs point to a relaunch coming soon; currently marked temporarily closed
data.short_description: Titus Burger, a dog-friendly burger spot with vegan options, is preparing to reopen in Titusville after a temporary closure, based on plan review paperwork filed for a new mobile food vendor. Owner Ender Molero was not immediately available for comment on reopening plans.

Achilito's Taqueria will open a new Back Bay/Fenway location in the former Little Steve's Pizzeria space, bringing its total locations to four. The fast-casual Mexican restaurant offers customizable burritos, bowls, tacos, and more.

data.location: CityNorth, north Phoenix, north of Loop 101 and west of 56th Street
data.short_description: Bistecca & Bones is an Italian chophouse and sister concept to Bourbon & Bones, pairing steaks with Italian dishes like pasta and seafood. It will feature tableside presentation, including Caesar salad and a flaming Bistecca Fiorentina.

data.location: The Sydney, near 90th Street and Loop 101, on Salt River Pima-Maricopa Indian Community land
data.short_description: This second Bistecca & Bones will span about 6,800 square feet in a two-story building at The Sydney, a $100 million, 26-acre retail and entertainment development. Square One expects to gain access to the space in summer 2027.

data.location: Upstairs at The Sydney, near 90th Street and Loop 101, on Salt River Pima-Maricopa Indian Community land
data.short_description: The second Old Town Ski Lodge will expand the concept to about 2,500 square feet with a wraparound patio, located upstairs from the new Bistecca & Bones at The Sydney. The design will include gondolas and ski chairs converted into seating, plus an ice bar built from a walk-in freezer.

Roe & Olivia's is a new restaurant from Charlotte chef Andres Kaifer and Miami chef Michael Beltran, taking over the former Giovanna's space with about 120 seats. The 3,644-square-foot restaurant will feature a menu with heavy Spanish and Cuban influence using local, seasonal ingredients.

data.location: 3351 N State Street, Unit 1, Bunnell, FL 32110
data.short_description: The Haggard Hare is opening its first brick-and-mortar cafe along US-1 in Bunnell, offering fresh-baked goods, pizza, and coffee. The child-friendly space will include a children's section, a library area, and workspace, and the owners are raising funds via GoFundMe for equipment and startup costs.

data.location: 1261 Park Ave, New York, NY 10029 (Upper East Side)
data.short_description: Creola is a Pan-African tasting menu restaurant from Top Chef alum Lana Lagomarsini, featuring an intimate 12-seat dining room. The five-course menu will draw on Pan-African diaspora flavors and is expected to evolve monthly based on local, seasonal produce.
